How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders are typically processed and shipped within 1 to 3 business days (Monday through Friday).
Once your order ships, you will automatically receive an email with your tracking number. Express orders placed before 1:00 PM CST ship the same business day, while orders placed after 1:00 PM CST or over the weekend ship the next business day.

Delivery times depend on the shipping method and destination:
• U.S. Orders: Domestic shipments are sent via USPS, FedEx, or UPS. Standard shipping generally arrives within a few business days after processing.
• International Orders: Standard international shipping usually takes about 1 to 4 weeks depending on the destination country and customs clearance, while express options (like DHL, UPS, or FedEx Express) are typically faster.
